ph_ranges.interpretation: Aluminium and Manganese toxicity, Phosphorus fixation by iron/aluminium oxides, microbial inhibition.
ph_ranges.amendment: Apply Agricultural Lime (CaCO3) or Dolomite @ 2-4 tonnes/ha based on buffer capacity.

ph_ranges.interpretation: Adequate for acid-tolerant crops (rice, tea, potato), slight P and Ca deficiency risk for vegetables.
ph_ranges.amendment: Apply light lime or maintain with farmyard manure and Rock Phosphate.

ph_ranges.interpretation: Maximum availability of primary (N, P, K), secondary (Ca, Mg, S) and micronutrients. Peak soil microbial activity.
ph_ranges.amendment: No amendment required. Maintain organic matter with regular compost/FYM addition.

ph_ranges.interpretation: Free calcium carbonate fixes Phosphorus as insoluble tricalcium phosphate; micronutrient precipitation (Zn, Fe chlorosis).
ph_ranges.amendment: Use acid-forming fertilizers (Ammonium sulphate, Single Super Phosphate), apply sulphur @ 200 kg/ha or green manure with Daincha.

ph_ranges.interpretation: High exchangeable sodium percentage (ESP > 15%), soil structural dispersion, zero infiltration, root toxicity.
ph_ranges.amendment: Apply Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) @ 4-6 tonnes/ha based on gypsum requirement followed by leaching with good quality water.

electrical_conductivity_ds_m.interpretation: Safe for all crops; no osmotic stress.
Yield reduction in sensitive crops (pulses, beans, tomato). Germination may be delayed.
Yield reduction of 25-50% in most field crops. Stunted vegetative growth, marginal leaf scorch.
Only salt-tolerant crops can survive (barley, sugarbeet, date palm). Heavy leaching and subsurface drainage mandatory.

low.interpretation: Poor biological activity, low water retention, high fertilizer leaching. Mandatory application of 15-20 t/ha FYM or 5 t/ha vermicompost.

medium.interpretation: Moderate organic status. Maintain with crop residue incorporation and seasonal green manuring.

high.interpretation: Excellent organic matter, high cation exchange capacity (CEC), active earthworms and beneficial microbes.

low.interpretation: Deficient: Increase recommended N dose by 25%.

medium.interpretation: Adequate: Apply standard 100% recommended dose of fertilizer.

high.interpretation: High: Reduce chemical N application by 25% to prevent vegetative lodging and disease surge.

low.interpretation: Deficient: Increase recommended P dose by 25% and use vesicular arbuscular mycorrhiza (VAM).

medium.interpretation: Adequate: Apply standard recommended P dose.

high.interpretation: High: Reduce chemical P application by 25-50%.

low.interpretation: Deficient: Increase K dose by 25% to bolster pest/disease defense and fruit quality.

medium.interpretation: Adequate: Apply standard recommended K dose in split applications.

high.interpretation: High: Reduce chemical K application by 25%.

zinc_ppm.remediation: Soil application of ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha or foliar 0.5% ZnSO4

iron_ppm.remediation: Foliar spray of 1% FeSO4 + 0.1% Citric acid

boron_ppm.remediation: Soil application of Borax @ 10 kg/ha or foliar 0.1% Solubor
